inputs.resume_text:
SNEHA PILLAI
PGP 2026-28, Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode
sneha.pillai@iimk.ac.in

EDUCATION
PGP, IIM Kozhikode, 2026-28, CGPA 5.9/10 (Term 1)
B.Sc. Biotechnology, Christ University, Bengaluru, 2026, 8.1/10
Class XII (CBSE), Kendriya Vidyalaya Pattom, 2023, 91%

INTERNSHIPS
Biocon Biologics | Research Intern | May - Jul 2025
- Assisted in stability testing of 2 biosimilar formulations; documented 60+ test runs
- Prepared a literature summary on cold-chain failures in insulin distribution in South India
Nature's Basket (Godrej) | Retail Marketing Intern, Kochi | Dec 2024 - Jan 2025
- Ran in-store sampling for an organic millet range across 3 outlets; sampling footfall converted at 18% vs 11% for the shelf-only week
- Collected feedback from 150 shoppers and suggested Malayalam shelf talkers, which were printed for the Kochi stores

POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
- Head, Cultural Committee, Christ University (2024-25): led a 25-member team for the annual fest with a footfall of 8,000
- Volunteer, Kerala flood relief collection drive, 2024

SKILLS AND INTERESTS
- Excel, Canva, basic R
- Classical Carnatic vocalist; Malayalam, Tamil, Hindi, English

claims.text: Assisted in stability testing of 2 biosimilar formulations; documented 60+ test runs
Prepared a literature summary on cold-chain failures in insulin distribution in South India
Ran in-store sampling for an organic millet range across 3 outlets; sampling footfall converted at 18% vs 11% for the shelf-only week
Collected feedback from 150 shoppers and suggested Malayalam shelf talkers, which were printed for the Kochi stores
Head, Cultural Committee, Christ University (2024-25): led a 25-member team for the annual fest with a footfall of 8,000
Volunteer, Kerala flood relief collection drive, 2024

concerns.detail: The resume moves from biotechnology studies and research into retail marketing and an MBA focused toward marketing.

plan.warmup_question: What topic from your first MBA term have you been curious to explore further?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your background, up to how your first term at the MBA has gone.

slots.core_question: What was the hardest part of leading the cultural committee's 25-member team?
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific challenge from the annual fest, Sneha's own leadership decisions, how she handled people or priorities, and what the 8,000-person event achieved.
likely_probes: How did you decide what to delegate?
What did you do first when the team disagreed?
How many people ultimately attended the fest?

slots.core_question: Tell me about a time you failed at something that mattered to you.
slots.intent_private: Needs a concrete failure, Sneha's specific contribution, how she responded, and what changed in her subsequent approach.
likely_probes: What was your specific contribution to the situation?
What did you do first after you realised it had gone wrong?
What outcome showed whether your response worked?

slots.core_question: Suppose a new healthy snack gets strong trial in stores but weak repeat purchase. How would you work out what to change?
slots.intent_private: Needs a first-year marketing approach that separates trial from repeat behaviour, combines customer feedback with sales evidence, and weighs the main trade-offs before recommending action.
likely_probes: Why would you start with that approach rather than another?
When might that approach give you a misleading answer?
How would you use something from your own internship to inform the decision?

slots.core_question: With a biotechnology degree and research experience, what's pulling you toward marketing?
slots.intent_private: Needs a motivation tied to Sneha's own experiences, a specific reason for pursuing marketing, and what she has done in the MBA so far toward this domain.
likely_probes: What experience first made marketing feel relevant to you?
What have you done in your MBA so far to explore marketing?
What other roles or companies are you considering?

plan.plan_notes: The plan prioritizes the substantial leadership activity because summers interviews should test extracurricular evidence, while the knowledge slot checks marketing fundamentals at a first-year MBA level. The resume also shows a biotechnology-to-marketing switch and a 5.9/10 first-term CGPA; the switch is covered through motivation, while the background walkthrough leaves room for the academic context.
